_comment: M4 Gemini-request reasoning: bare includeThoughts-only creates no effort intent and keeps its existing independent loss (strict 400 TRANSLATION_LOSS, zero IO). No reasoning field is faked upstream. GREEN on baseline (probed); guards that includeThoughts never becomes an effort control.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "gem-chat"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
name: m4_reasoning_gemini_chat_includethoughts_only
